§6Lens Block§f is the heavy optical component used inside the Observatory and as a critical ingredient for the Vacuum-Chamber Laser Emitter. It is the first crafted component in the AR progression that requires a multiblock machine to produce.

Recipe in the Precision Assembler: 1 Iron Rod + 3 Lenses + 3 Glass, at 100 ticks per block. The block transmits light like vanilla glass but emits a soft glow when powered.

§cWARNING:§f A single Lens Block needs 3 Basic Lenses from the Precision Assembler. That makes the Lens the real bottleneck, not the glass or iron rod. Stock up on silicon wafers before you start.

§ePS:§f You cannot hand-craft this. The Precision Assembler is mandatory.
